(Optional) This text will appear in the inbox preview, but not
the email body. It can be used to supplement the email subject
line or even summarize the email's contents. Extended text
preheaders (~490 characters) seems like a better UX for anyone
using a screenreader or voice-command apps like Siri to dictate
the contents of an email. If this text is not included, email
clients will automatically populate it using the text (including
image alt text) at the start of the email's body.
